description: Fleet defaults for every repository on GitHub and Gitea (mlorentedev/ci-workflows#30). Plain JSON with no GitHub-only option, so a Gitea run can extend it too. A repository adds only its own managers and rules on top.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of a repository go in one weekly PR. Majors stay individual: the review question is different, and a major buried in a group merges unread.
An action bump changes CI, not the shipped code, so it must not cut a fix release through release-please.
